"Himedica" is not a widely recognized medical brand or standard industry term for continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) or wearable ECGs
; you may be referring to generic or lesser-known import smartwatches marketed with health tracking features, or standard remote patient monitoring (RPM) ecosystems. Clinically validated consumer wearables for ECG, sleep, and fitness include devices like the
Apple Watch
or
Samsung Galaxy Watch
, while true continuous glucose monitoring requires dedicated medical sensors like Dexcom or Abbott FreeStyle Libre.
